title: Answer: life is what simple machines build by following their rules, with algorithms stored in DNA

statements.text: Matter As Machine gives no definition of life, and places it in the one process of execution. Simple machines follow their rules, combine, fail, survive and combine again, with no global plan, and that is enough for complexity, life and civilization to appear. Evolution is this slow creation, and what it creates and stores in DNA is algorithms, some more efficient than others.

sources.quote: They only need to follow their rules, combine, fail, survive, and combine again. That is enough for complexity to grow. That is enough for life to appear.
What evolves in evolution? What is stored in DNA? Algorithms.
